up: Show the first 200 metabolism records involving CYP2C8. sql: WITH cyp2c8_targets AS (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE pref_name = 'CYP2C8'), metabolism_cte AS (SELECT met_id, drug_record_id, substrate_record_id, pathway_id, pathway_key, enzyme_name, enzyme_tid, met_conversion, organism, tax_id, met_comment FROM metabolism WHERE enzyme_tid IN (SELECT tid FROM cyp2c8_targets) LIMIT 200) SELECT m.met_id, s.canonical_smiles, cs.substrate_name, cd.parent_name, m.met_conversion, m.pathway_key, m.organism FROM metabolism_cte m LEFT JOIN compound_structures s ON m.substrate_record_id = (SELECT molregno FROM compound_records WHERE record_id = m.substrate_record_id) LEFT JOIN (SELECT cr.record_id, md.pref_name AS substrate_name FROM compound_records cr JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno) cs ON m.substrate_record_id = cs.record_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT cr.record_id, md.pref_name AS parent_name FROM compound_records cr JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno) cd ON m.drug_record_id = cd.record_id LIMIT 200

up: Show the first 200 metabolism records where the enzyme is CYP2C8. For each record, return the substrate structure (canonical SMILES), substrate compound name, parent drug name, metabolic conversion description, pathway key, and organism.
sql:
WITH metabolism_data AS (
  SELECT
    m.met_id,
    m.drug_record_id,
    m.substrate_record_id,
    m.met_conversion,
    m.pathway_key,
    m.organism
  FROM metabolism m
  WHERE m.enzyme_name = 'CYP2C8'
  LIMIT 200
)
SELECT
  md_sub.chembl_id AS substrate_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md_sub.pref_name AS substrate_name,
  md_parent.pref_name AS parent_drug_name,
  m.met_conversion,
  m.pathway_key,
  m.organism
FROM metabolism_data m
JOIN compound_records cr_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cr_sub.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md_sub ON cr_sub.molregno = md_sub.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md_sub.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr_parent ON m.drug_record_id = cr_parent.record_id
LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md_parent ON cr_parent.molregno = md_parent.molregno
